limitations: Eight synthetic English cases, two repetitions, one model. The same cases informed development; this is not an independent holdout or a general quality benchmark.
Answers, usage and client latency are recorded measurements. Costs are cached-token-aware list-price estimates, not invoices, realized savings or ROI; infrastructure is excluded.
Selected context reduced input tokens and estimated cost, but median latency rose from 2157 ms to 2454 ms. The smaller observed p95 is not an SLA.
Price freshness and gate results describe the recording date, not current prices or permission to deploy.
GlobalStandard processing is not limited to the account region. Confirm residency requirements separately.
The pinned model requires an availability and retirement check before reuse; there is no automatic model replacement.
Identity-recovery routing uses a bounded English intent rule, not a general natural-language policy classifier.
The original report digest identifies the source of this curated example. It is not a service signature or independent execution attestation.
